_doc: Audio coverage manifest for the Muntin library. Source of truth for which written pieces ship a 'Listen to this article' studio audio edition, in which languages.
_status: v1 — 2026-05-08. Tracks the studio-tier audio rollout. The pipeline that consumes this is scripts/render-post-audio.mjs (synthesis) + scripts/lib/translate.py (translation) + scripts/check-audio-coverage.mjs (audit).

_languages.en: English — primary, narrated by F5-TTS voice clone (Don) when available, otherwise Kokoro am_michael

_voice_canon: One curated Kokoro voice per language, used across the entire library so brand recognition compounds. Don may swap voices via render-post-audio.mjs --kokoro-voice-<lang> when a better voice ships.
_translation_canon: Each non-EN edition runs the source EN chunks through scripts/lib/translate.py — document-context batched translation with the GLOSSARY of brand + restaurant-industry terms preserved. The ES edition for posts with a hand-translated ES mirror SHOULD use --use-existing-translations against the ES article HTML so the audio matches Don's authored Spanish prose. Other languages use translate.py.
_pronunciation_canon: data/audio-pronunciation.json holds per-locale phonetic overrides. Kokoro applies them via the espeak phonemizer hint; terms not in the dictionary use Kokoro's default pronunciation.

_pieces._doc: Each entry: { path, title, languages, status, owner }. Path is repo-root-relative without /index.html. Languages declare which audio editions this piece SHOULD ship; the audit complains when an entry is missing on disk. Status: 'rendered' (audio exists for every declared lang), 'partial' (some langs missing or stale), 'pending' (no audio yet). Owner is who narrated (kokoro, f5).

es-blog._doc: Spanish-only blog slugs (no EN counterpart). Their audio chunks come from the ES article HTML directly; other languages translate from the ES source.

library._doc: Phase 7: evergreen library articles. Same render + audit pipeline as /blog/; entries are added here as posts migrate from /blog/ into /library/ (Wave 4). Files live at /library/<slug>/audio.mp3 and audio.<lang>.json. Each entry's GUID for RSS purposes is stable across the blog→library move (see scripts/build-rss.mjs).

restaurant-schema-markup-guide.needs_rerender: Wave 5 fold from restaurant-schema-markup-complete-paste-ready-example added 209 lines; audio chunk map is stale for the appended sections.

reservation-conversion-guide.needs_rerender: Wave 5 fold from five-restaurant-website-changes-recover-one-percent-margin + how-to-recover-reservations-from-googles-find-a-table added 308 lines; audio chunk map is stale for the appended sections.

third-party-delivery-economics.needs_rerender: Wave 5 fold from is-doordash-worth-it-for-restaurants-in-2026 added 222 lines; audio chunk map is stale for the appended sections.

es-library._doc: Phase 7: ES counterparts to /library/ articles. Populated as ES files migrate in Wave 4b. ES rename and merge target slugs are decided alongside translation review and not back-filled mechanically.

como-salir-de-doordash-mi-restaurante.note: ES counterpart of third-party-delivery-economics; standalone ES merge primary (no native ES counterpart of the EN primary "an-honest-doordash-math" exists in the slug map).

los-6-tipos-de-schema-markup-que-google-.note: ES counterpart of restaurant-schema-markup-guide. ES does NOT have a folded equivalent of the EN secondary (no ES translation of restaurant-schema-markup-complete-paste-ready-example exists); audio reflects just the primary content.

checklists._doc: Long-form structured pieces. Both deferred from the studio-audio rollout pending a structural fix: their <main id='post-body'> wraps multiple sibling <section> elements with nested <div class='container'> wrappers. The chunk extractor's nth-of-type direct-child selectors don't resolve through that nesting, so the on-page highlight would silently fail on every chunk. Two routes forward: (a) restructure each checklist's HTML so audio-eligible h2/p/li are direct children of post-body, or (b) ship a recursive chunk extractor with stable data-audio-chunk-id attributes (TODO).

audit-any-tool.defer_reason: post-body wraps <main> with nested <section><div class='container'><h2/p/li>... — extractor selectors don't resolve at runtime

restaurant-website-checklist.defer_reason: same as audit-any-tool, plus 2,500-line length amplifies the impact of any selector misalignment

_skipped._doc: Sections deliberately excluded from audio narration.
_skipped.topics: /learn/topics/<slug>/ — nav hubs (a few sentences + lists of articles); audio narration of a nav hub doesn't serve the listener.
_skipped.glossary: /glossary/<slug>/ — definitional pages (often <300 words); the per-term popover already reads the definition; no value in standalone audio editions.
_skipped.tools: /tools/<slug>/ — interactive tools, not articles; audio narration would describe a UI the listener should be touching.
_skipped.sheets: /sheets/<slug>/ — operator worksheets; the value is in filling them in, not listening to them.
